checks.explanation: Total US federal debt reached roughly $37.6-38.4 trillion by the end of 2025, close to but somewhat below the predicted $40 trillion figure.
Cost Plus Drugs has continued to grow rapidly, but it remains a small player relative to the major pharmacy benefit managers, short of the dramatic market-share shift implied.
No broad government mandate requiring full pricing transparency across all healthcare contracts has been implemented, so this prediction's premise has not been tested.
The agents-as-feature-versus-product debate remains unresolved, with both standalone agent startups and embedded agent features coexisting in the market.
This is a longer-term prediction about a future proliferation of personalized AI models that has not yet been reached at the scale described.
